game.title: Hollow Knight
game.summary: A 2D metroidvania with an emphasis on close combat and exploration in which the player enters the once-prosperous now-bleak insect kingdom of Hallownest, travels through its various districts, meets friendly inhabitants, fights hostile ones and uncovers the kingdom's history while improving their combat abilities and movement arsenal by fighting bosses and accessing out-of-the-way areas.

game.title: Hollow Knight
game.summary: Unofficial port of the hit game Hollow Knight for PlayStation Vita.

game.title: Hollow Knight: Silksong
game.summary: Hollow Knight: Silksong is the epic sequel to Hollow Knight, the epic action-adventure of bugs and heroes. As the lethal hunter Hornet, journey to all-new lands, discover new powers, battle vast hordes of bugs and beasts and uncover ancient secrets tied to your nature and your past.

game.title: Hollow Knight Gun Mod
game.summary:
A Hollow Knight mod that gives the Knight the ability to wield a modern day assault rifle. Why did I make this? I wish I knew too.

While this mod is not to be taken seriously, It still aims to make a semi-serious fun ranged weapon mod to capitalize on Hollow Knight's movement system.

game.title: Hollow Knight: Pale Court
game.summary:
The unofficial expansion mod is finally here!
Challenge Hallownest's mightiest champions in grand combat!
Overcome your opponents with powerful new charms!
Discover new secrets and stories!
All with an incredible new soundtrack!

game.title: Hollow Knight Randomizer
game.summary: Welcome to Randomizer 4, the newest version of the Hollow Knight item and transition randomizer released for the Hollow Knight 1.5 update.

game.title: Hollow Knight Multiplayer
game.summary: As the name might suggest, Hollow Knight Multiplayer (HKMP) is a multiplayer mod for the popular 2D action-adventure game Hollow Knight. The main purpose of this mod is to allow people to host games and let others join them in their adventures. There is a dedicated Discord server for the mod where you can ask questions or generally talk about the mod.

game.title: Hollow Knight: The Glimmering Realm
game.summary:
A mod for the game Hollow Knight that adds a game mode with a whole new world to explore - the Glimmering Realm!

Changes the layout, items and lore of Hallownest into a whole new realm
No map included, draw your own or venture forth without guidance
Adds a new game mode, all old save files will remain unchanged

game.title: Hollow World: Dark Knight
game.summary: Use various hand-to-hand combat skills to defeat hordes of mystical enemies and save the world!
